name: Magic Gamesys Tweaks
description: Game-system tuning via gamesys.fit: LOS and max weapon range 250; weapon range bands 0-80/50-160/80-240; basic sensor gains range; weapons always 100% for player and AI; AI pilot skill by class (Green 50 / Regular 75 / Veteran 100 / Elite 125). type=assets so the launcher treats it as a stackable add-on, NOT a campaign (gamesys.fit is in data/missions but is tuning, not playable missions).
